scripts.android:copy: npm run build && npx cap copy android
scripts.android:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync android
scripts.icon:generate: npm install -D @capacitor/assets && npx @capacitor/assets generate --iconSourcePath ./assets/icon.png --splashSourcePath ./assets/splash.png || npx @capacitor/assets generate
scripts.android:sdk:install: bash -lc 'set -e; SDK_ROOT="$HOME/android-sdk"; mkdir -p "$SDK_ROOT"; if [ ! -x "$SDK_ROOT/cmdline-tools/latest/bin/sdkmanager" ]; then cd /tmp; rm -f commandlinetools-linux.zip; wget -q https://dl.google.com/android/repository/commandlinetools-linux-11076708_latest.zip -O commandlinetools-linux.zip; rm -rf "$SDK_ROOT/cmdline-tools/latest" "$SDK_ROOT/cmdline-tools/new"; mkdir -p "$SDK_ROOT/cmdline-tools/new"; unzip -q commandlinetools-linux.zip -d "$SDK_ROOT/cmdline-tools/new"; mv "$SDK_ROOT/cmdline-tools/new/cmdline-tools" "$SDK_ROOT/cmdline-tools/latest"; rm -rf "$SDK_ROOT/cmdline-tools/new"; fi; export ANDROID_SDK_ROOT="$SDK_ROOT"; export PATH="$ANDROID_SDK_ROOT/cmdline-tools/latest/bin:$ANDROID_SDK_ROOT/platform-tools:$PATH"; yes | sdkmanager --licenses >/dev/null; sdkmanager "platform-tools" "platforms;android-34" "build-tools;34.0.0"; echo "Installed Android SDK at $ANDROID_SDK_ROOT"; echo "Run: export ANDROID_SDK_ROOT=$ANDROID_SDK_ROOT"; echo "Run: export ANDROID_HOME=$ANDROID_SDK_ROOT"'
scripts.android:sdk:setup: bash -lc 'set -e; SDK_DIR=""; for d in "$ANDROID_SDK_ROOT" "$ANDROID_HOME" /usr/local/lib/android/sdk /opt/android-sdk /opt/android/sdk /usr/lib/android-sdk "$HOME/Android/Sdk" "$HOME/android-sdk"; do if [ -n "$d" ] && [ -d "$d/platforms" ]; then SDK_DIR="$d"; break; fi; done; if [ -z "$SDK_DIR" ]; then echo "Android SDK not found. Run: npm run android:sdk:install"; exit 1; fi; mkdir -p android; ESCAPED=$(printf "%s" "$SDK_DIR" | sed "s|/|\\/|g"); printf "sdk.dir=%s\n" "$ESCAPED" > android/local.properties; echo "Using Android SDK at $SDK_DIR"'
scripts.icons:sync: npm run icons:generate && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:apk: npm run build && npx cap sync android && npm run android:sdk:setup && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.android:apk:codespaces: bash -lc 'set -e; JAVA_HOME=""; for d in /usr/lib/jvm/java-17-openjdk-amd64 /usr/lib/jvm/msopenjdk-17-amd64 /usr/lib/jvm/temurin-17-jdk-amd64 /usr/lib/jvm/java-21-openjdk-amd64 /usr/lib/jvm/temurin-21-jdk-amd64 /opt/java/openjdk /usr/local/sdkman/candidates/java/*; do if [ -d "$d" ]; then case "$d" in *17*|*21*) JAVA_HOME="$d"; break;; esac; fi; done; if [ -z "$JAVA_HOME" ]; then ALT_JAVA="$(update-alternatives --list java 2>/dev/null | grep -E "(17|21)" | head -n 1 || true)"; if [ -n "$ALT_JAVA" ]; then JAVA_HOME="$(dirname "$(dirname "$ALT_JAVA")")"; fi; fi; if [ -z "$JAVA_HOME" ]; then echo "No supported JDK 17/21 found."; echo "Current java:"; java -version || true; echo "Java alternatives:"; update-alternatives --list java || true; echo "Try installing JDK 17, then re-run this command."; exit 1; fi; export JAVA_HOME; export PATH="$JAVA_HOME/bin:$PATH"; echo "Using JAVA_HOME=$JAVA_HOME"; java -version; npm run android:apk'
